blocks.text: This Vehicle Purchase Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{date}}, by and between:
Seller: {{seller_name}}, with a principal address at {{seller_address}} ("Seller")
Buyer: {{buyer_name}}, with a principal address at {{buyer_address}} ("Buyer")
Seller and Buyer may be referred to individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."
The Parties agree that the vehicle subject to this Agreement is described as follows:
The total purchase price for the Vehicle is {{purchase_price}} (the "Purchase Price"), payable as follows:

items: Down Payment: {{down_payment}} (paid upon execution of this Agreement)
Seller is the legal owner of the Vehicle and has full authority to sell it.
The Vehicle is free and clear of all liens, encumbrances, and security interests, except as disclosed in writing to Buyer.
Seller will deliver a valid, properly assigned title to Buyer at the time of sale.
Seller has not previously sold, offered to sell, or contracted to sell the Vehicle to any other person.

blocks.text: The Vehicle is sold "as-is" unless otherwise stated in this Agreement. Seller makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding the Vehicle's condition, merchantability, or fitness for a particular purpose.
Seller certifies that the odometer reading stated above reflects the actual mileage of the Vehicle to the best of Seller's knowledge.
Seller makes the following representations and warranties:

items: The Vehicle has not been declared a total loss by any insurance company.
The Vehicle has not been salvaged, reconstructed, or flood-damaged (unless disclosed).
All information provided by Seller regarding the Vehicle's history and condition is true and accurate.
Seller has disclosed all known material defects to Buyer.

blocks.text: If Buyer fails to pay the remaining balance by the due date, Seller may:

items: Declare the Agreement void and retain any down payment as liquidated damages.
Pursue legal remedies for breach of contract.
Demand return of the Vehicle if delivered prior to full payment.

blocks.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of {{governing_state}}.
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
